newsitem.title: HONG KONG: NWI takes 3 pct of Jiangsu Expressway.
newsitem.headline: NWI takes 3 pct of Jiangsu Expressway.

text.p: New World Infrastructure Ltd (NWI) said on Thursday it would take a three percent stake in Chinese toll road operator Jiangsu Expressway Co Ltd.
"NWI will take a three percent stake of the company at a price equivalent to their issue price," an NWI spokesman said. "The acquisition will be funded by internal resources."
The spokeman gave no details on the actual investment sum.

Jiangsu Expressway is expected to issue 1.222 billion H-shares or 25 percent of its enlarged share capital at a price ranging from HK$2.62 to HK$3.04 each, representing a prospective price to earnings multiple of 33 to 38 times on a fully-diluted basis. The issue price is expected to be fixed on June 13.
H-shares are Chinese enterprise shares listed in Hong Kong.
COSCO Pacific Ltd and Shanghai Industrial Holdings Ltd are also expected to take a strategic stake in the toll road operator, market sources said.
"The three companies are expected to take up a total of about 10 percent of the issued share capital of the company," said a source close to the underwriters.
COSCO and Shanghai Industrial officials were not immediately available for comment.

Taking into account of Jiangsu Expressway's acquisition plans, the issue price will represent a discount to NAV (net asset value) of 14 to 24 percent, compared with about five to 17 percent discount prior to the acquisitions, sources said.
Jiangsu Expressway is expected to hold a presentation for analyst on Friday before it kicks off its road show in Singapore, New York and London later, market sources said.
About 90 percent of the issue is earmarked for international placement and 10 percent will be offered to the public in Hong Kong, sources said.
The company is expected to hold a media briefing on June 17 before it runs the public offering in Hong Kong from June 18 to 23. Dealing in the shares is expected to begin on June 27.
HSBC Investment is expected to be the sponsor of the issue.

Jiangsu Expressway, controlled by the Communications Department in China's Jiangsu province, owns and operates the Jiangsu section of Shanghai-Nanjing (Huning) Expressway connecting Shanghai and Nanjing. Total investment for the 247-km long Jiangsu section is about 6.2 billion yuan.
The company had said earlier it would use the proceeds to repay loans, to buy an interest in Jiangsu National Highway and to participate in other highway development projects.
